response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong open-source and mentoring credentials, but he does not meet the core technical bar for this role: the job requires 8 years of C++ programming experience and 5 years building large-scale infrastructure/distributed systems, whereas his career is centered on TypeScript/Node.js, JavaScript, DLang, and web/mobile stacks with only a brief ~6-month C/C++ stint at National Instruments. There is no evidence of cloud compute platform architecture or formal technical leadership over cloud/DevOps engineers, making him a poor fit for this specific C++-centric infrastructure leadership role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience (15+ years) across web, mobile, and backend systems
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing through workshops, talks, and open-source projects
Experience with distributed/high-throughput systems (e.g., micro-services handling millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments) vs. required 8 years
No demonstrated experience with cloud compute platforms, hardware architecture, or storage systems at scale
No clear evidence of formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers or owning large ambiguous infrastructure projects

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute/infrastructure platform experience
Strong mentoring and technical leadership soft skills
